metadata.summary: The Sleep-EDF (Expanded) database provides full-night polysomnography (PSG) recordings for sleep research, including two cohorts: healthy subjects (SC) and subjects with mild difficulty falling asleep (ST). Each recording contains EEG (Fpz-Cz, Pz-Oz), EOG, submental EMG, and event markers, manually scored with the R&K sleep-stage standard.
metadata.purpose: Sleep research, particularly automatic sleep-stage classification and sleep analysis.
metadata.avoided_uses: Clinical decision support in modern clinical settings due to dated acquisition period and R&K scoring (not AASM).

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified; PhysioNet standard de-identification procedures applied.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PhysioNet data sharing policies; no explicit mention of GDPR/HIPAA given collection era and jurisdiction.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。

known_limitations: Dated data (1987–1994); outdated acquisition hardware/software and sleep staging criteria (R&K, not AASM).
Limited demographic and clinical diversity: healthy/insomnia skew, not representative of general clinical population.
bias_sources: Clinical selection bias (healthy vs. mild insomnia only)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Cohort overrepresents healthy adults and those with mild insomnia; underrepresents severe, comorbid, pediatric, and elderly populations.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability to contemporary clinical sleep populations due to temporal, demographic, and methodological (scoring standard) shifts.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage details reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity).

data_origin.selection_rationale: Cohorts selected as healthy subjects (SC) and subjects with mild difficulty falling asleep (ST).
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Not explicitly described; appears to be convenience sampling from a single-center sleep study.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected 1987–1994; known temporal shift relative to current sleep staging standards (R&K vs. AASM) and equipment/software.

population.target_population: Adults with and without mild insomnia symptoms.
population.inclusion_criteria: Healthy subjects or subjects with mild difficulty falling asleep.
population.missing_groups: General clinical population (e.g., severe insomnia, comorbid psychiatric/neurological conditions, pediatric/elderly extremes) is underrepresented.

annotation.annotation_method: Manual scoring using Rechtschaffen & Kales (R&K) sleep-stage standard.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Manually scored by experts per R&K standard.
annotation.label_noise_description: R&K scoring differs from current AASM standard; inter-rater variability not quantified in source text.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Clinical deployment for diagnosis or treatment decisions.
